description: Equity, free margin, used margin and open profit or loss on every exchange account the user connected (Hyperliquid, Bybit, Binance, OKX, sandbox), and the total. Use to report balances or to compare free margin across exchanges. Not needed before opening: size_position_by_risk reads equity itself. Not for positions (use get_my_open_positions). No inputs. Amounts in USD (USDC / USDT count as USD). Next: get_my_open_positions.
